mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month compresses equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI exceeds 5.0%, persistent inflation triggers hawkish monetary policy expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as earnings growth prospects deteriorate.
evidence_refs: fact:HOUST fell to 1793.0 (March 2022), RSAFS fell to 667724.0 (March 2022)
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for interaction signal falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), rising payroll employment growth (PAYEMS > 0.5% MoM) signals labor market tightness that pressures corporate margins, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
evidence_refs: fact:Trigger condition defined as UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS MoM growth > 0.5%
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances meeting trigger condition, or Rank IC for interaction signal falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production over the prior two months indicates manufacturing output weakness, reducing corporate profitability expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO declines over prior two months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1800.0 thousand units, it signals residential sector contraction that reduces consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST < 1800.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high interest rate regime (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), a decline below 1.5% triggers monetary easing expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances meeting trigger condition, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate and declines in payroll employment indicate labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE rises and PAYEMS declines, or Rank IC for interaction signal falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
